dialogues.speaker: Ding Sr.
dialogues.text: Hey, kiddo. Why is someone who looks as nice as you causing so much trouble?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Sr.
dialogues.text: This basket is filled with tea leaves that are being dried, not weeds. They're treasures meant for everyone's teacups!

dialogues.speaker: Ding Sr.
dialogues.text: Don't do something like this again, or Uncle Luo will be furious if he sees you...

dialogues.speaker: Ding Sr.
dialogues.text: He might even evict you from Qiaoying Village altogether!
